You synthesize string transformation programs from input/output examples.
Return exactly one expression derived from nonterminal S of the supplied grammar.
Use SMT-LIB string syntax. Return only the expression, without Markdown, explanations,
a define-fun wrapper or additional expressions. Use only the supplied productions,
variables and literal constants. The expression must satisfy all constraints.
The examples are the only task-specific specification you receive.

Synthesize f(x). The grammar and all 5 examples are:

(set-logic SLIA)
(synth-fun f ((x String)) String ((S String (x "" " " " (" " (+" " -> " " 0" "(" ")" ") -> " "); " "+" "," ", " "-" "01:00 PM -> 05:00 PM" "03:00 AM -> 11:00 AM" "07:00 AM -> 10:00 AM" "10:00 PM -> 05:00 PM (+1 day)" "12:00 PM -> 09:00 PM" ":" ":00 " ";" "; " ">" "M -> " (str.++ S S) (str.at S I) (str.substr S I I) (str.replace S S S) (ite B S S))) (I Int (-1 0 1 2 3 4 5 (str.len S) (str.indexof S S I) (+ I I) (- I I))) (B Bool ((str.contains S S) (str.prefixof S S) (str.suffixof S S) (= S S) (= I I)))))
(constraint (= (f "LH789; MUC -> JFK; 01:00 PM -> 05:00 PM") "01:00 PM -> 05:00 PM"))
(constraint (= (f "AA789; JFK (New York, USA) -> LAX (Los Angeles, USA); 07:00 AM -> 10:00 AM") "07:00 AM -> 10:00 AM"))
(constraint (= (f "AF567; CDG (Paris Charles de Gaulle, France) -> DXB (Dubai, UAE); 03:00 AM -> 11:00 AM") "03:00 AM -> 11:00 AM"))
(constraint (= (f "BA321; LHR (London Heathrow, UK) -> DXB; 12:00 PM -> 09:00 PM") "12:00 PM -> 09:00 PM"))
(constraint (= (f "BA456; LHR -> SIN (Singapore); 10:00 PM -> 05:00 PM (+1 day)") "10:00 PM -> 05:00 PM (+1 day)"))
(check-synth)
